inputs: SP 800-38A Appendix F.5 AES-128-CTR four-block vector
expected: All four ciphertext blocks match the NIST values; decryption with the same operation recovers all four plaintext blocks
limitations: One official four-block case; it checks the CTR formula and vector, not protocol behavior.

inputs: The third block of the NIST CTR vector decrypted independently from the first two blocks
expected: Direct keystream generation for block 3 recovers the same plaintext as full decryption
limitations: Demonstrates random access on one fixed block; it does not benchmark parallelism.

inputs: Two fixed plaintexts under the same AES-128 key and initial counter block, then under a different initial counter block
expected: Same-counter ciphertext XOR equals plaintext XOR; a different initial counter block breaks the relation
limitations: Arithmetic consequence of keystream reuse; it does not model a full protocol attack.

inputs: The standard incrementing function applied to 32-bit and toy 8-bit counter fields, including wrap-around
expected: Only the rightmost m bits change; an 8-bit counter returns to its start after 256 increments
limitations: Toy field size; the 32-bit case does not iterate 2^32 blocks.

expected: Ciphertext length equals plaintext length in both cases; no padding block is added
limitations: Length behavior only; it does not test long-message counter limits.
